paragraphs.text: He accuses man's ingratitude, which cannot depend on God's power.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: He shows that God's providence not only watches over his Church in general, but also over every member of it.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: Neither heat nor cold, nor any inconvenience will be able to destroy God's Church, even though for a time they may molest it.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: Whatever you attempt will have good success.
paragraphs.label: d
paragraphs.anchor: going out and thy coming in
